about: Every headline claim, its basis and whether it may be shown. GREEN: implementation and source checked. AMBER: shown only with its qualification. RED: must not appear as an established result. A unit test (frontend/src/services/claims.test.ts) fails if the wording of a RED claim appears on any live surface.

claims.claim: Real NISAR measurements of the event are loaded
claims.basis: Pair A GUNW/GOFF and Pair B GOFF COGs, each tagged with its granule ID; Provisional, CRID P05023

claims.claim: Coherence 0.19 against 0.46 (frame 74) and 0.16 against 0.52 (frame 75), inside the UNOSAT extent against a 1 km ring
claims.basis: data/qa/pair-a-analysis.json, valid-mask pixels only: 36.5% of the extent in frame 74 and 44.0% in frame 75. No independent validation
claims.action: The story and SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION now state the valid share. Confirm after the rebuild (coherence validity is unchanged by P0.1)

claims.claim: At the source, Pair A has no data because it falls in a swath gap
claims.basis: The product's own mask flags all 307 frame-74 pixels; whether as water or an invalid subswath has not been read
claims.resolution: Withdrawn 13 Nov: replaced by 'the product's own quality mask flags the zone (water or an invalid subswath, not yet told apart)'
forbidden: because it falls in a swath gap
which fall in a swath gap

claims.claim: At the source, a surface change was visible on 66% and movement measurable on 0%
claims.basis: Observability version 1 ignored the product's masks (S1)
claims.resolution: Withdrawn 12 Nov: the app withholds version 1 figures (observabilityCurrent, tested in finding.test.ts and observability.test.ts) until the rebuild
forbidden: a surface change was visible on
a surface change could be seen on

claims.claim: Mudflow coherence fell from 0.41 to 0.28 while nearby ground went from 0.42 to 0.52
claims.basis: Medians from an earlier script that is not in the repository; the pairs differ in length (24 and 12 days) and radar mode (4000 and 2000)
claims.action: Disclose the confounds; replace with prepare_control_series.py output at the rebuild

claims.claim: The drop is specific to the mudflow, not the season
claims.basis: Causal attribution from one comparison
claims.resolution: Withdrawn 12 Nov: 'consistent with surface change in the mapped area; it does not establish the cause'
forbidden: specific to the mudflow, not the season

claims.claim: NISAR saw the Rasuwa mudflow change the ground
claims.basis: As C06
claims.resolution: Withdrawn 12 Nov: the headline now reports that coherence fell inside the mapped area
forbidden: saw the Rasuwa mudflow change the ground

claims.claim: Pair B correlation peak 0.18 at the source against 0.63 nearby
claims.basis: pair-b-analysis.json, frame 16: the peak is valid on all 307 source pixels; 60% of range offsets there are flagged or masked

claims.claim: Removing the ionosphere screen cuts phase scatter from 8.87 to 4.79 and from 6.41 to 1.98 rad
claims.basis: Whole-frame standard deviation across components; the sign is chosen empirically

claims.claim: Pixel offsets show no large coherent shift
claims.basis: GOFF layer 3, which has the smallest search window; raw values reach about 280 m
claims.action: The search-window limit is now stated in the story, README and SCIENTIFIC_VALIDATION

claims.claim: No displacement is calculated
claims.basis: True since 12 Nov: Tsho Rolpa movement bounds are research output only; no displacement layer exists (App.test.tsx)

claims.claim: The Tsho Rolpa dam moved less than about 2 cm, with no sign that it is slumping
claims.basis: S5: phase converted to centimetres without a confirmed convention or reference
forbidden: no sign that it is slumping

claims.claim: The glacier moved less than about 0.2 m in 12 days, or roughly 6 m a year
claims.basis: A 12-day bound extrapolated to a year

claims.claim: Tsho Rolpa measured 1.59 to 1.62 km², no change beyond about ±0.09 km²
claims.basis: Four GCOV dates, same track and frame; the ±0.09 km² is half the largest change between the −8 and −6 dB thresholds
claims.action: Called a method range, not a formal error (13 Nov)

claims.claim: The lake area matches published figures
claims.basis: About 1.55 km² (2008 survey), 1.61 km² (Peppa et al., 2020, ISPRS Annals V-3-2020) and 1.65 km² (2022 DHM bathymetric survey, as reported by Dialogue Earth)
claims.action: Cited 13 Nov. Obtain the DHM survey report itself

claims.claim: Dam-break arrival times and depths along 107 km
claims.basis: Assumed breach depths of 10, 20 and 30 m; peak-flow formulas differ about tenfold; no attenuation downstream
claims.action: Move out of the primary demonstration

claims.claim: Next: a forecast of the lake's size in 2030 and 2040
claims.basis: No method or long series

claims.claim: Terrain screen: 56% of the detachment zone High or Very high, AUC 0.66
claims.basis: One event; every unmapped pixel treated as a negative; neighbouring pixels not independent (S10)
claims.action: Called a one-event consistency check, not a validation, in the manifest, status registry and docs (13 Nov)

claims.claim: Roads: 73 km High exposure; 109 km beyond the frame checked
claims.basis: Rule thresholds are project choices; radar-watch rating uses version 1 flags until the rebuild

claims.claim: What-if flood: places below the water
claims.basis: Height above the nearest river point only
claims.action: Move out of the primary demonstration

claims.claim: "Best supported" explanation
claims.basis: A rule count that could rise without a measurement (S7)
claims.resolution: Fixed 12 Nov: only radar values at the spot and independent mapping count; labels are Fits the checks, Partly fits, Little support

claims.claim: Runs offline from one click
claims.basis: The CSP offline browser test passes on vite preview; the packaged .bat has not been rerun since 2 Nov

claims.claim: Product maturity Provisional (P05023), read from the file DOI
claims.basis: manifest.maturity()

claims.claim: UNOSAT mudflow extent 64.91 km²
claims.basis: Computed in UTM 45N; press figures of about 30 km² are not reconciled

claims.claim: Following Earth's movement, one radar observation at a time
claims.basis: No movement is measured anywhere in the app
claims.resolution: Rephrased 13 Nov: 'Following change on Earth's surface'
